# Review

## Outcome

**Request Changes**

## Evidence

- Reviewed `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:9-83` and `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:117-175`: save loading now uses a contiguous `MIGRATIONS` registry with a compile-time length invariant, and `SaveFile::from_value` applies ordered migrations plus explicit too-new/too-old version checks before deserialization.
- Reviewed `crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:67-91` and `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:187-209`: the schema-4 additions (`animal.reserve_g` and the shrimp feeding parameters) are all `#[serde(default)]`, so the documented no-op `migrate_v3_to_v4` is consistent with the migration contract.
- Reviewed `crates/tank_api/src/handlers/save.rs:19-25` and `crates/tank_tui/src/lib.rs:234-241`: API JSON loads now go through `SaveFile::from_value`, and TUI disk loads now go through `SaveFile::from_json`, so migration/version checks are no longer bypassed on those paths.
- Reviewed `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:157-325`: coverage exercises v2->current migration, legacy saves missing `stability_tracker`, future-version rejection, too-old rejection, zero-version rejection, and building an engine after migration.
- Validated with `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load`, `cargo test -p tank_tui`, and `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_tui -- -D warnings`; all passed.

## Findings and Gaps

- `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:274-276` does not actually keep the alkalinity budget in sync after comammox. `let _alk_budget = (alk_budget - comammox_alk_cost).max(0.0);` creates a new shadow variable instead of mutating the existing `alk_budget`, so the added fix is currently a no-op and the comment is misleading. Any later code that reads `alk_budget` after comammox would still see the pre-comammox value.

## Follow-up and Amendments

- Replace the shadowing binding at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:276` with a real update of `alk_budget`, or remove the dead future-proofing/comment if no downstream consumer exists yet.
- After correcting that line, rerun the focused validation (`cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load`, `cargo test -p tank_tui`, and `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_tui -- -D warnings`).
